from pathlib import Path

import pytest

NOTES_DIR = "notes"


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first name in `names` readable from `notes`.

    Each name is looked up inside the directory `notes` (relative to the
    working directory). Names are untrusted: any name that would resolve to
    a location outside `notes` (via "..", an absolute path, a symlink, etc.)
    is treated as unreadable and skipped. Missing files, directories,
    undecodable files, permission errors and malformed names (e.g. with a
    NUL byte) are also skipped. Returns "" when no name is readable.
    """
    try:
        root = Path(NOTES_DIR).resolve()
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
        return ""
    for name in names:
        try:
            candidate = (root / name).resolve()
            if candidate == root or not candidate.is_relative_to(root):
                continue
            return candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
            continue
    return ""


def _setup(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
    notes = tmp_path / NOTES_DIR
    notes.mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET", encoding="utf-8")
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    return notes


def test_returns_first_readable(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a.txt", "b.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_skips_missing(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "b.txt").write_text("beta", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["missing.txt", "b.txt"]) == "beta"


def test_empty_and_none_readable(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    assert first_readable([]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["nope.txt", "also-nope.txt"]) == ""


def test_notes_dir_missing(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["a.txt"]) == ""


def test_subdirectory_file_allowed(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (notes / "sub" / "c.txt").write_text("gamma", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["sub/c.txt"]) == "gamma"


def test_directory_and_dot_names_skipped(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    (notes / "ok.txt").write_text("ok", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["", ".", "sub", "ok.txt"]) == "ok"
    assert first_readable(["", ".", "sub"]) == ""


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad",
    [
        "../secret.txt",
        "sub/../../secret.txt",
        "../../secret.txt",
        "..",
        "./../secret.txt",
    ],
)
def test_traversal_rejected(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, bad: str
) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "sub").mkdir()
    assert first_readable([bad]) == ""


def test_traversal_skipped_then_next_used(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt", "a.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_absolute_path_rejected(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    assert first_readable([str(tmp_path / "secret.txt")]) == ""


def test_symlink_escape_rejected(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    try:
        (notes / "link.txt").symlink_to(tmp_path / "secret.txt")
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks unavailable")
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["link.txt", "a.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_symlink_inside_notes_dir_escape_via_dir(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    try:
        (notes / "outdir").symlink_to(tmp_path, target_is_directory=True)
    except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
        pytest.skip("symlinks unavailable")
    assert first_readable(["outdir/secret.txt"]) == ""


def test_nul_byte_name_skipped(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["a.txt\x00../secret.txt", "a.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_undecodable_file_skipped(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "bin.dat").write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\x00\x80")
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["bin.dat", "a.txt"]) == "alpha"


def test_empty_file_is_readable(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    notes = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (notes / "empty.txt").write_text("", encoding="utf-8")
    (notes / "a.txt").write_text("alpha", encoding="utf-8")
    assert first_readable(["empty.txt", "a.txt"]) == ""
